test_suite: AgroVision AI 2.0 - Phase 7 Agricultural Knowledge Base & Recommendations Test Suite

test_results.message: Verified all 75 knowledge records have strictly unique IDs.
100% of knowledge records map to verified Phase 2 crop and disease canonical registries.
All 75 knowledge records strictly conform to knowledge_base_schema.json.
All knowledge records reference registered sources (PJTSAU, ANGRAU, ICAR, CIBRC).
Verified all chemical recommendations have CIBRC statutory registration or university POP backing.
Verified viral diseases strictly omit direct chemical cures and restrict to vector IPM.
Verified regional applicability covers PJTSAU and ANGRAU agroclimatic zones in Telangana and AP.
Verified all 8 non-supported diagnostic statuses strictly withhold chemical sprays and supply safe referral guidance.
Successfully returned source-backed IPM, distinguishing symptoms, and Tricyclazole label treatment for Rice Blast.
Missing knowledge record failed safely with KVK referral without falling back to generic chemical sprays.
Verified GET /diagnosis/v1/knowledge/{disease_id} returns record on match and 404 on unknown.
Zero regressions on /predict/predict-yield and Phase 5 diagnostic routers.
